name: Abhishek Bhaskar Kadam
headline: Java Full Stack Developer | Spring Boot | Microservices | Angular
tagline: Java full stack engineer focused on scalable BFS applications, microservices transformation, backend reliability, and user-centric product delivery.
summary: Java Full Stack Developer with 2+ years of experience designing and supporting enterprise-grade applications across backend services, microservices migration, API development, and Angular-based UI work. Experienced in building resilient Spring Boot systems, working with Kafka-based integrations, improving code quality, performing production debugging, and supporting deployment pipelines in Agile environments.
highlights: Designed and maintained REST APIs and backend services using Java and Spring Boot for scalable enterprise systems.
Worked on monolith-to-microservices migration and event-driven communication with Apache Kafka.
Refactored legacy Java modules, removed 2400+ lines of obsolete code, and improved maintainability and release stability.
Migrated legacy JavaScript flows to Angular and improved frontend responsiveness by 25%.
Worked across the full SDLC with Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, JUnit, SonarQube, and production observability tools.
